title: GLASS ADJUSTMENT PROCEDURE
summary: Convertible (19467) side door glass adjustment, 17 steps: fit the windshield-side weatherstrip and retainer, set the door glass with its guide cams, idler cams, anti-rattle cushions and up/down stops, then after the body is on the frame fit the convertible top, set glass height and fore/aft, align the rear edge to the rear weatherstrip and adjust the top side-rail weatherstrips. Sections are on the next sheet (K15).

fastening.to: birdcage (windshield pillar), through the w/shield side w/strip retainer
fastening.note: Hold the w/shield side w/strip retainer. Step 1: lower two started loose. Step 8: after drilling the birdcage hole via the w/strip clearance hole, torque all three.

Guide cam upper bolts: two on the front cam (step 6a, once front-edge engagement and parallelism are set, Section A-A), two on the rear cam (step 16b, once the rear edge meets the rear w/strip, Section D-D).
Two idler cam bolts (step 6b). Step 12, after body drop: loosen to correct the glass front-edge angle to the w/shield, then retorque.
Locks each anti-rattle cushion. Step 7: front cushion pressed outboard firmly onto the glass, then torqued. Step 16c: rear cushion bolt, torqued after that cushion is pressed out against the glass.
Two screws for the front and rear upper stops; stops set against the window rollers, then torqued (step 14). Sets glass full-up height.
Three screws "F" set the glass fore and aft relationship (step 13).
Rear guide cam lower bolt (step 16a); the cam is adjusted at the belt line until the glass rear edge meets the rear w/strip (Section D-D).
Two screws for the lower stop: with the glass top edge lowered flush to the door outer panel, set the stop to the roller and torque (step 15).

Side rail w/strip screws: left loose while fitting the top (step 10). Step 17: the top's side upper w/strip assemblies are moved in/out for seal interference (Section C-C), then the w/strip bolts are torqued.
Rear w/strip screws, torqued in step 16d once the rear w/strip and glass have been brought parallel together (Section D-D).

notes: ON TRIM LINE BEFORE BODY DROP
1. Fit the w/shield side w/strip retainer; start only its lower two screws "[?]", loose.
2. Glue the w/shield side w/strip into the retainer, its top trim line flush to the header molding's upper outer corner. Keep cement off the back of the w/strip above the retainer.
3. Hang the side door glass and its related parts; leave the bolts into the door inner panel loose.
4. Raise the glass until its front corner sits about .50 in. under the corner header molding's front upper corner.
5. Slide the glass forward just enough to start it into the w/shield side w/strip retainer's groove.

6. At the belt line, press glass and w/strip retainer outboard until the glass's nylon stabilizer button meets the inner panel's wedge surface. Position the glass front edge engaged in, and parallel to, the w/strip (Section A-A). Torque: a. front guide cam upper bolts "B" (2); b. idler cam bolts "C" (2).
7. Press the front anti-rattle cushion outboard until it bears firmly on the glass; torque bolt "D".

8. Lower the glass to reach the retainer screws. Coat the w/strip's upper surface with cement and place it on the body, its upper end flush with the header molding's upper corner. Through the w/strip's clearance hole, drill the mounting hole in the birdcage. Torque all three screws "A".
9. Check door-to-body fit and lock-to-striker alignment; fix any misalignment caused by mounting the body on the frame.
10. Fit the convertible top and adjust it to the body. Set the top's front header against the w/shield header per Sections B-B, C-C and E-E. Leave the side rail w/strip screws loose.

11. Raise the glass to give at least .06 swing clearance to the side w/strip's outer lip. Using the final height setting, shift the glass fore or aft for the correct interference fit with the w/shield side w/strip (Section A-A).

12. Recheck that the glass front edge is parallel to the w/shield, in case body mounting threw it off. If not, loosen both bolts "C", correct the angle, and retorque. When doing this, hold the step 11 setting at the same time.
13. Torque the three screws "F" to lock the fore/aft position.
14. Bring the front and rear upper stops against the window rollers; torque both screws "E".
15. Lower the glass until its top edge sits flush with the door outer panel. Bring the lower stop against the roller and torque both screws "H".

16. At the belt line, adjust the rear guide cam so the glass rear edge meets the rear w/strip (Section D-D). Move the w/strip and glass together until parallel. Press the rear anti-rattle cushion outboard until it bears firmly on the glass. Torque: a. rear guide cam lower bolt "G"; b. rear guide cam upper bolts "B" (2); c. rear anti-rattle cushion bolt "D"; d. rear w/strip screws.
17. Shift the convertible top side upper w/strip assemblies in or out for the seal interference shown in Section C-C; torque the w/strip bolts. See Sheet K11.
